csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEngine.UI; using System.Text; using System.Linq; using System.Collections.Generic; public class Script { static void Walk(Transform t, string indent, StringBuilder sb) { var comps = new List<string>(); foreach (var c in t.GetComponents<Component>()) { if (c == null) continue; var ct = c.GetType().Name; if (ct == "RectTransform" || ct == "Transform") continue; string extra = ""; if (c is Image img) extra = " spr=" + (img.sprite != null ? img.sprite.name : "null") + " color.a=" + img.color.a.ToString("F2"); if (c is CanvasGroup cg) extra = " alpha=" + cg.alpha; comps.Add(ct + extra); } sb.AppendLine(indent + t.name + (comps.Count > 0 ? " [" + string.Join(",",comps) + "]" : "")); foreach (Transform child in t) Walk(child, indent + "  ", sb); } public static string Main() { var sb = new StringBuilder(); var allGos = Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll<GameObject>(); var go = allGos.FirstOrDefault(g => g.name == "SpinButton" && g.scene.IsValid()); if (go == null) return "SpinButton: NOT FOUND"; Walk(go.transform, "", sb); return sb.ToString(); } }
